summary: The roughly half-acre '20th Street Plaza' of the D4D open-space network (Section 3.10), the landscaped entry plaza on Parcel K North's 20th Street frontage at Illinois Street, designed as the gateway from Dogpatch to the Historic Core with an entry plaza, seating terrace and planted garden. The Port's Parcel K North project lists a 20th St/Illinois St plaza among the buyer's obligations; it has not been built.

milestones.text: Port Commission approves subdividing the 20th/Illinois parcel to create a separate 'Plaza Parcel' alongside Parcel K North (Resolution 17-52 recitals)
Planning's Parcel K North design approval covers the vertical improvement; the Port's project page describes the project as the building 'with a plaza and street improvements'

SF Planning Commission adopts the Pier 70 Special Use District Design for Development (D4D) by Resolution No. 19980; the Port Commission's Item 9B staff report from the same period (approvals adopted Sept 26, 2017) names the '20th Street Plaza' among the Illinois Street Parcels' infrastructure obligations alongside Michigan Street and Irish Hill Park

facts.value: 3.10 '20th Street Plaza', zone 6 of the eight public open spaces in Figure 3.4.1

Entry plaza at 20th and Illinois (with interpretive signage and wayfinding, possibly a cafe along 20th Street), seating terrace and planted garden; illustrative section shows about 85 ft of entry plaza, a 51 ft planted garden and a 75 ft seating terrace between Illinois and Michigan Streets
'simple and not detract from the presence of Buildings 101 and 113-116'
Parcel K North buyer (TMG Partners / Presidio Bay Ventures) per the Port's project description of a 20th St/Illinois St plaza and Michigan Street improvements
CFD special taxes from Parcel K North and the Hoedown Yard were projected in 2017 to fund maintenance of open space and streets north of 20th Street

open_questions: This project's geometry file records the zone as an unnamed 'PKN frontage open space'; the D4D names it the 20th Street Plaza (Section 3.10, Figure 3.10.1). Worth updating the geometry file's regulatory_context (not done here per the brief).

Whether the 'Plaza Parcel' created in 2017 was conveyed with Parcel K North or retained by the Port, and who will build the plaza if the PKN building stays unbuilt, is not stated in the retrieved documents.

No basis for an expected-completion date was found: this plaza is delivered by the Parcel K North buyer, whose own building has no target date (see the Parcel K North record's open questions), and no separate schedule for the plaza itself was found, so this record stays undated.
